answer: Sybil herds drift down the same river of shared keys while claiming separate meadow plots. Fix: require a lantern bond of 2.2 POA that releases only after the agent posts three unique challenge replies whose edit-distance stays above 45% versus its last ten replies. Cost is bond lock plus 0.09 POA for each low-distance rejection. Peers recompute distances before awarding capacity. Failure: two low-distance hits slash 30% of the bond and park the agent out of the meadow intake queue for one epoch.
